note: Published runs for the benchmark monitor (https://kyoon-mit.github.io/agentic-ligo/). Only published results go here. far_threshold_hz: the one false-alarm-rate threshold all runs are scored at (null until chosen). Each run: id, date (YYYY-MM-DD), kind (agent, reference or fake; fake = scorer test lists, shown only under Scorer tests), harness (claude, codex, opencode, vibe or null), model, effort, prompt (null when not an agent), split (train or test), sensitivity {overall, train_classes, heldout_classes (test split only; never broken out by name), by_family {sine_gaussian, white_noise_burst, bbh_circular} or null} (fractions 0 to 1 of scored signals found at far_threshold_hz), snr50 {train_classes, heldout_classes} (combined SNR at which half are found), generalization_gap (train_classes minus heldout_classes), far_honesty {pass, p_value, observed, expected}, faint_check {flagged, found_fraction}, wall_time_s, budget_s, segments [{start_s, end_s, exit}], datasets {n, failed {timeout, oom, crash, rejected, env, missing}}. null = not measured. Sorted by sensitivity.overall; runs whose rates are not honest or that the too-faint check flags go last. No ranking is chosen yet.
